text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗪𝗜𝗡 𝗨𝟭𝟵 𝗔𝗦𝗜𝗔 𝗖𝗨𝗣! 🇮🇳🔥

Chasing 338 v Pakistan, India won by 1 wicket off the LAST ball.
Mohit Ulva hit 49* off 26, finishing with a four. A record 9th title.

Pure nerves of steel 👏

#U19AsiaCup #Cricket

𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗡𝗘 𝗝𝗜𝗧𝗔 𝗟𝗜𝗬𝗔 𝗨𝟭𝟵 𝗔𝗦𝗜𝗔 𝗖𝗨𝗣! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 Pakistan U19 ne banaye 337/9, India ko chahiye the 338
👉 India U19 ne 339/9 banaye aur 1 wicket se jeete, aakhri gend par!
👉 Mohit Ulva ne 26 gend mein 49* thoka, last ball par chauka maara
👉 Sehwag aur Raichandani ki 95 run ki opening stand, aur ye India ka record 9th title

Kaisa laga ye thriller? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #U19AsiaCup #TeamIndia
